{{for|the [[Two Rivers]] farmer|Hari Coplin}}
'''Hari''' was a [[Dragonsworn]] follower of [[Masema Dagar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Hari}} 

== Appearance ==
He had narrow eyes and was stubble-cheeked, with a thrusting nose. He wore a string of ears around his neck and a coat too large for him.

== Activities ==
He, with a group of Dragonsworn attacked [[Morgase Trakand]] and her group while traveling through [[Ghealdan]]. They are saved by [[Perrin Aybara]] who sent Hari back to the Prophet telling him murder will not be accepted. He was present during the meeting with the Prophet and Perrin.

He was in the tent with the [[Shaido]] prisoners, torturing them. Perrin walked in and kicks the hot coals off the prisoner towards Hari.

It can be assumed he died in the [[Battle of Malden]] or soon after when [[Cha Faile]] ambush Masema and his men.
